findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "send_email" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "gateway" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_email · Private data: validate_email · Public sink: validate_email, send_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_email · Private data: validate_email · Public sink: validate_email, send_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
